source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-43

procedures.title: Evaporator core: replace
steps: Purge the refrigerant from the system.
Take off the carburetor air cleaner.
Disconnect the expansion valve inlet line and the POA valve outlet line; cap and seal all open lines immediately.
Remove the windshield wiper door actuator assembly and the POA valve bracket-to-case screws.
Disconnect every wire and vacuum hose attached to the evaporator assembly.
Remove the cover-to-firewall stud nuts and the cover-to-evaporator case screws (some engines need the A.I.R. combustion pipe removed).
Pull the cover out and up without damaging the core.
Remove the core retaining screws and lift out the core.
Add 3 fluid oz. of refrigeration oil for a new core, then evacuate and charge the system.

specs.what: oil added with new evaporator core

notes: The core comes out without removing the whole evaporator/blower unit.
See figure 49 in the manual (POA valve installation).
